h1: Grandview Condominia — Budget Stays with Private Balconies on Lat Phrao Soi 1
intro: The upper Lat Phrao corridor — anchored by Ha Yaek Lat Phrao (Five-Way Intersection), Union Mall, and Central Plaza Ladprao — is one of Bangkok's most practical districts for budget travelers who drive. Grandview Condominia (OYO 75417) sits right on Lat Phrao Soi 1, Lane 4-3, in the Chatuchak subdistrict, offering condo-style rooms with private balconies and free on-site parking. From approx. ฿670/night for a Standard Double, it's among the most affordable options in the area with those two features combined.

body.html: Location & Getting Around — The hotel's address is 225/9 Soi Lat Phrao 1, Lane 4-3, Chom Phon subdistrict, Chatuchak District, Bangkok 10900. That puts it on the main Lat Phrao corridor near the five-way intersection (Ha Yaek Lat Phrao). Union Mall is roughly 900 metres away — walkable in cooler weather or a quick motorcycle taxi ride. MRT Phahon Yothin station is about 1.1 km north, reachable by Grab or a short motorbike ride to connect with the Blue Line into central Bangkok. Chatuchak Weekend Market is about a 4-minute drive, and Don Mueang Airport is roughly 15 km away.

Rooms & What You Actually Get — The building has around 80 condo-style rooms split across three main types: Standard Double (one double bed), Deluxe Triple (three beds), and Family Suite (two double beds). The private balcony in every room is the standout feature, and several reviewers mention that room sizes are more generous than typical Bangkok budget hotels at this price point. All rooms have air conditioning, TV, and free Wi-Fi. Some room types include a mini-fridge. That said, reviews from Booking.com, KAYAK, and Trip.com consistently flag quality inconsistencies — some rooms are clean and functional while others show signs of wear, including moisture on walls and dusty balconies.
"Room is nice and very spacious — the balcony is a real bonus at this price. Wi-Fi was slower than advertised but AC worked well."

Facilities — Free on-site parking is the most notable amenity, and a genuine advantage in an area where street parking is scarce. Multilingual staff are available. Daily housekeeping is offered. However, front-desk coverage is not 24 hours in the traditional sense — guests may need to contact the property via LINE app for late check-ins or after-hours requests, which some guests found inconvenient. There is no swimming pool, gym, or on-site restaurant, which fits the OYO budget-hotel model focused on value over amenities.

What Real Guests Say: Pros and Cons — Drawing from Agoda (195 reviews, 7.0/10), Booking.com (57 reviews, 6.2/10), and Trip.com (5 reviews, 6.1/10), the picture is mixed but legible. Positives: Spacious rooms and balconies for the price, working air conditioning, functional hot water, free parking, and proximity to Union Mall and shopping. Concerns: Cleanliness is the most repeated issue — some guests report dirty balconies (bird droppings), musty smells, or damp walls in certain rooms. Wi-Fi speed was flagged as slow or inconsistent in multiple reviews. Water pressure was low in some rooms. Toiletries were limited or not restocked.

Pricing & Value — Standard Double rooms start from roughly ฿670/night (approx. $18–19 USD) in low season, rising to ฿800–900 on weekends or holiday periods. The Deluxe Triple runs around ฿926 and the Family Suite around ฿1,200. For a private balcony room with free parking in Bangkok, those prices are genuinely competitive. Where the value proposition weakens is if you encounter one of the less-maintained rooms — the gap between best and worst rooms appears wider here than at more consistent mid-range options.

Bottom Line — Grandview Condominia is a budget pick that punches above its weight on space and free parking while sitting in a convenient Lat Phrao location. The private balcony every room is a real differentiator. However, honesty requires noting that the property's overall scores (6.2–7.0 across platforms) and specific cleanliness complaints make it a somewhat uncertain choice. It works well if your priorities are low price, parking, and a location near Union Mall and Chatuchak — and if you go in with realistic expectations for a budget OYO property.

honestSummary: Grandview Condominia delivers a private balcony and free parking from around ฿670/night — two things that are genuinely hard to find together in Lat Phrao. But cleanliness and service consistency are real question marks, and mid-range review scores across platforms reflect that honestly.
honestChecks: If consistent cleanliness is non-negotiable for you — the property scores 6.5/10 on cleanliness (Booking.com), with specific complaints about damp walls and dirty balconies in certain rooms. Consider 48 Metro Hotel or T3 Residence Ladprao for higher consistency at a similar budget.
If you rely on fast Wi-Fi for work or streaming — multiple reviews flag slow or inconsistent speeds. Bring a backup mobile hotspot or local SIM data to stay connected reliably.
If you plan a late-night arrival — front desk coverage is not 24/7 in the traditional sense; contact the property via LINE in advance and confirm your exact arrival time to avoid issues at check-in.

faq.q: Where is Grandview Condominia located, and is it close to an MRT station?
faq.a: Grandview Condominia is at 225/9 Soi Lat Phrao 1, Lane 4-3, Chatuchak District, Bangkok 10900. MRT Phahon Yothin station is approximately 1.1 km away — a short motorcycle taxi or Grab ride. Union Mall is closer at around 900 metres.

faq.q: What is the starting price at Grandview Condominia Bangkok?
faq.a: A Standard Double room starts from approx. ฿670/night (around $18–19 USD) in standard periods. The Deluxe Triple is around ฿926, and the Family Suite around ฿1,200. Prices vary by season and platform, so compare before booking.

faq.q: Does Grandview Condominia offer free parking and Wi-Fi?
faq.a: Yes to both — free on-site parking is available for guests (worth confirming during busy periods), and free Wi-Fi is included in all rooms. Multiple reviews note that Wi-Fi speed can vary by room and time of day.

faq.q: Who is Grandview Condominia best suited for?
faq.a: It works best for budget-conscious travelers driving their own car, or small groups wanting a spacious room with a private balcony at a low price in the Lat Phrao district. Less suitable for guests who prioritize spotless rooms and 24/7 hotel service.

faq.q: Is Grandview Condominia near restaurants and shopping?
faq.a: Yes — Union Mall is about 900 m away, with food courts, shops, and cafes. Central Plaza Ladprao (with extensive dining and retail) is ~1.1 km. Chokchai 4's famous 24-hour street-food strip is about 8 minutes by car.
